plate_comment: Counts passes (limit 200) while the position sensor status is above 0 or the position control error is set, and clears the count otherwise; the second word of variable_geometry_turbocharger_fault_holdoff_flags is 0 only during the first 200 passes of such a fault and 1 otherwise. Read by cm848_sequenceVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionAdjustment, which drops the logical output 72 request during that hold-off. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionStartupCounter)
evidence: code: body read; xref: the hold-off flags (0x3fb07c) are read only by cm848_sequenceVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionAdjustment and the counter (0x3fb080) is private to this function; request 72 is set in the normal state and cleared during the 200-pass window, so this is an enable being dropped, not an event raised.

plate_comment: Counts the first 60 passes after boot (variable_geometry_turbocharger_mission_reset_window_counter) and sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_mission_reset_detected_flag when engine speed in that window is at or above variable_geometry_turbocharger_mission_reset_speed_threshold (4800 = 600 rpm), i.e. the ECM restarted while the engine was running. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionWarmupTrigger)
evidence: code: timer saturates at 60 and the flag is (timer < 60 && current_rpm >= word); its only consumer latches it in the closed-stop stage, which then switches the key-on drives off. e2m: C_VGA_Mission_Reset_Speed / VGA_Mission_Reset_Detected have the same roles.

plate_comment: Key-on stage that drives the valve to its closed stop: latches the mission reset, tracks the engine stop transition, waits until the sensor reads within actuator_e_end_margin of 12800 or variable_geometry_turbocharger_stop_seek_retry_time passes, then keeps variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_stop_diagnostic_drive_flag on for variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_active_time passes and sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_ready_for_closed_adjustment_flag; it also copies the closed-stop drive duty (+30 percent) to variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_stop_diagnostic_drive_duty_working. (was cm848_evaluateLoadProtectionFuelLowStage)
evidence: code: not a fuel stage - it reads no fuel word; the 2000-pass time-out, the 12800 end test and the mode 4 output (+3840) were checked in the body and in cm848_selectActuatorEControlMode. e2m: C_VGA_PWM_Closed_Diag_Value / VGA_PWM_Closed_Diag_Override / VGA_Ready_For_Closed_Adjust.

plate_comment: Sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_near_open_stop_flag when the sensor value is within variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_tolerance (3200) of the expected open-stop reading, i.e. |(closed position - sensor value) - 12800| < tolerance. (was cm848_calculateLoadProtectionDeviationFlag)
evidence: code: body read; dump 1693: |(12800 - 1693) - 12800| = 1693 < 3200 gives 1 as in the dump; the flag is used only as the open stop reached test. No e2m used.

plate_comment: Stage that drives the valve to its open stop: latches variable_geometry_turbocharger_fault_open_hold_request_flag when the sensor or span is faulty, sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_open_stop_diagnostic_drive_flag (actuator E mode 3, duty -3840 before the mode output limits) while the engine is not spinning or the hold is latched and variable_geometry_turbocharger_open_stop_dwell_counter is below variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_active_time, latches variable_geometry_turbocharger_open_stop_reached_flag when the sensor is near the open stop or variable_geometry_turbocharger_stop_seek_retry_time passes have elapsed, and sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_ready_for_span_adjustment_flag. (was cm848_evaluateLoadProtectionOverspeedStage)
evidence: code: disassembly checked (r4 after the call is variable_geometry_turbocharger_stop_seek_retry_time, the retry time); no speed is compared. e2m: VGA_PWM_Open_Diag_Override / VGA_Ready_For_Span_Adjust.

plate_comment: Per-pass sequencer of the position adjustment, run when variable_geometry_turbocharger_enable_flag is set: selects the drive duty limit (variable_geometry_turbocharger_drive_duty_limit_over_temperature / variable_geometry_turbocharger_drive_duty_limit_over_current / variable_geometry_turbocharger_drive_duty_limit_normal), derives the motor and position fault flags, requests logical output 72 unless the fault hold-off or a pending driver fault is present, runs the closed-stop and open-stop seek stages and sets the closed and span adjustment enables. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionArming)
evidence: code: body read; called per pass from cm848_phase_common_processing before cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerPosition. It arms nothing about load. Logical output 72 is the neighbour of the direction output 71 of the actuator E loop (e2m: VGA_PWM_Enable follows VGA_Motor_Cmd_Closing_Direction); the identity of 72 is e2m / adjacency only.

plate_comment: Boot-time reset of the stop-seek sequencing state: clears the fault flags, engine-spinning flags, wait / dwell / mission-reset counters and the closed-stop, open-stop and fault-open-hold latches; the adjustment error counters and latches are not touched. (was cm848_clearLoadProtectionConfirmState)
evidence: code: body read (17 stores); called from the init sequence next to cm848_initializeVariableGeometryTurbochargerAdjustmentFilters.

plate_comment: Over-current check of the valve motor driver, run when the module is enabled: while governor_rpm_monitored (the estimated motor current) is at or above governor_rpm_monitor_threshold (14336 = 14 A at 0.000976562 A per count) an accumulator grows by 10 per pass (falls by 3 otherwise) and flags the over-current at 4000; a second accumulator (+2000 per flagged pass, limit 30000) and a 192-pass clear timer decide retry or give-up, and fault 745 (mask 512) of fault_detected_bits_736_to_751 is set or cleared accordingly. (was cm848_updateGovernorDemandRateProtection)
evidence: code: body read; it never reads channel 101; the eight words 0x4077a8-0x4077b6 (192, 2000, 30000, 1, 4000, 14336, 3, 10) are the accumulator limits and steps in the order of e2m C_VGA_Driver_OC_Clear_Time .. Time_Incrt (0x01190B00-0E); 14336 x 0.000976562 = 14.0 A. governor_rpm_monitored is the |applied voltage - back-EMF| / resistance estimate of governor_rpm_monitor_calc (EMF factor and current clamp words sit at the e2m C_VGA_Speed_EMF_Factor / Max_Current offsets; its square is filtered with the Current_Avg_Fil_Cnst word).

plate_comment: Boot-time reset of the driver over-current check: zeroes both accumulators, the clear timer and the flags and clears fault 745 (mask 512) in the detected and registered fault words. (was cm848_clearGovernorDemandRateProtectionState)
evidence: code: body read; the cleared flags are exactly the ones cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerDriverOverCurrentFault writes.

plate_comment: Debounce and latch of the closed adjustment error: the delay counter runs to variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_delay_time while the closed adjustment is enabled; once elapsed, the error counter rises each pass the sensor is outside the closed position tolerance and falls each pass it is inside; at variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_fault_time (200) the error is latched, released at 0, and variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_error_counter_clear_cal forces 0. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionConfirmCounterA)
evidence: code: body read; with the dump delay limit 0 the elapsed flag is 1 even while the adjustment is disabled, which is why the counter sits at 200. e2m: C_VGT_Pos_Adjust_Enable_Time / C_VGT_Pos_Adjustment_Fault_Time / T_VGT_Clr_Adjustment_Error_Cnt.

plate_comment: First-order filter of the closed-stop reading: follows variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_sensor_value only while variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position_valid_flag is set, otherwise holds; stores variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position_filtered and variable_geometry_turbocharger_saved_closed_position_cal, forces 12800 while fault 670 is set and substitutes variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position_override_value when variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position_override_enable_cal is set, giving variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionEmaOutput)
evidence: code: body read; the old reading filtered engine_load_percent, but the filter input is 0x40bdb6 (xref: 8 reads, 0 writes) and engine_load_percent (0x40af24) is read by none of the cluster functions. e2m: VGT_Filtered_Closed_Position / VGT_Closed_Position / T_VGT_Closed_Position.

plate_comment: Closed position adjustment: flags variable_geometry_turbocharger_closed_position_out_of_tolerance_flag (|12800 - sensor value| >= actuator_e_end_margin), runs the closed error latch, marks the closed reading valid when it is inside the tolerance with the delay elapsed, latches a time-out error when the closed-stop drive ends without a valid reading, sets or clears fault 670 (mask 16384 of fault_detected_bits_656_to_671) and its registered copy, then updates the filtered closed position. (was cm848_evaluateLoadProtectionSteadyStage)
evidence: code: body read; fault 670 is the confirm-A bit of the old reading and is also the clamp condition of cm848_calculateActuatorESetpoint. e2m: VGT_Closed_Adjustment_Error is mask 16384 of 0x01103652.

plate_comment: Debounce and latch of the span adjustment error, same scheme as the closed adjustment latch but on the span out-of-tolerance flag and the span delay and error counters; the latched flag drives fault 671. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionConfirmCounterB)
evidence: code: body read; mirror of cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerClosedAdjustmentErrorLatch with the span words.

plate_comment: First-order filter of the span (closed position minus sensor value): follows variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_measurement while variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_measurement_valid_flag is set, otherwise holds the saved span minus variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_key_on_decrement (applied once after boot) with a floor of 12800 - variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_tolerance; stores variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_filtered and variable_geometry_turbocharger_saved_span_cal, forcing the floor while fault 670 is set. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionLoadFilter)
evidence: code: body read; not a load filter - its input is A - x, not a load. e2m: VGT_Filtered_Span / T_VGT_Adjusted_Span / C_VGT_Span_Fail_Decrement.

plate_comment: Span adjustment: measures the span (variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_measurement), flags it outside variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_tolerance around 12800, arms the adjustment while the open-stop drive or the zero-setpoint hold is active, runs the span error latch (fault 671, mask 32768 of fault_detected_bits_656_to_671), marks the measurement valid inside the tolerance with the delay elapsed, then filters the span; the working span variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_adjusted is variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_override_value when variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_override_enable_cal is set. (was cm848_evaluateLoadProtectionLiveStage)
evidence: code: body read; fault 671 is the confirm-B bit of the old reading. e2m: VGT_Span_Adjustment_Error is mask 32768 of 0x01103652.

plate_comment: Normalises the sensor value to a position with 12800 = 100 percent: ((sensor value - closed position) + span) x 12800 / (max(span, 12800 - span tolerance) - closed stop gap), clamped to +-12800, into variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_adjusted. With the dump overrides (closed position 12800, span 12800, gap 1920) this is sensor value x 12800 / 10880, so 1693 gives 1991. (was cm848_calculateLoadProtectionDerateTarget)
evidence: code: dump check 1693 x 12800 / 10880 = 1991.8 and both 0x40b098 and actuator_e_feedback read 1991; nothing derates engine speed - the result is the feedback of the actuator E loop. e2m: VGT_Position_AP.

plate_comment: Runs the closed position adjustment and the span adjustment, forms the intermediate position status (sensor fault status OR 8 when fault 671 is set) and then calculates the adjusted position; called by cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerPosition. Replaces the engine-load-protection reading: nothing here reads engine_load_percent or derates speed. (was cm848_processLoadProtectionStatus)
evidence: code: body read; its typed local holds 8 from fault 671 only. Kept from the old plate: the call order and the caller; dropped: monitored quantity (engine load), derate, fuel-mode-B, SPN 0x48 event.

plate_comment: Chooses the position fed to the actuator E loop: actuator_e_feedback is variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_adjusted with source 0 when the status is clear (sensor status 0, no span adjustment error, no position control error), otherwise variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_sensor_default_value (9216 = 72 percent) with source 2; also builds variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_status = status | 8 for a span or closed adjustment error | 32 for the position control error (fault 743). (was cm848_calculateDiagnosticStatusBits)
evidence: code: body read; the 9216 default is the channel config word. e2m: VGT_Position_Source 0 primary / 2 default, VGT_Position_Status.

plate_comment: Per-pass entry of the position processing, run when variable_geometry_turbocharger_enable_flag is set: copies the sensor high / low faults 682 / 683 of fault_detected_bits_672_to_687 to faults 709 / 710 of fault_detected_bits_704_to_719 (and clears the registered copies), then runs cm848_evaluateVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionAdjustments and cm848_selectVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionSource. (was cm848_updateLoadProtectionStatusAndDerate)
evidence: code: body read; high_fault_bit 682 / low_fault_bit 683 are the 8th / 9th arguments of the channel 101 call, 682 = word 42 bit 10 (mask 1024), 683 = bit 11 (mask 2048). e2m: VGT_Position_PP_High_Error / PP_Low_Error at masks 32 / 64.

plate_comment: Boot init: sets variable_geometry_turbocharger_span_key_on_decrement_pending_flag, starts the span filter from variable_geometry_turbocharger_saved_span_cal and the closed-position filter from variable_geometry_turbocharger_saved_closed_position_cal, points both filters at variable_geometry_turbocharger_adjustment_filter_coefficient, clears the two closed-adjustment latch flags and, when variable_geometry_turbocharger_enable_flag is 0, clears the position error faults 709 / 710. (was cm848_initFaultStatusFilterState)

plate_comment: Periodic read of sensor channel 101 (called once per pass from cm848_phase_common_processing): linearises the ADC value through the channel table, debounces the high / low faults 682 / 683 and filters it into variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_sensor_value, with variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_sensor_default_value and variable_geometry_turbocharger_position_sensor_fault_status as the other outputs. (was cm848_protection_init_configBundle)

plate_comment: Boot-time first pass of sensor channel 101 (called from the init sequence): loads the first position sensor value, default and status through updateSensorChannelWithConfig with the same arguments as the periodic read. (was cm848_protection_update_configBundle)

text: VERDICT (old reading: partly kept, mostly wrong). Sensor channel 101 is the position sensor of the valve actuator of a variable-geometry turbocharger, and the 18 cluster functions are its key-on stop-seek and position adjustment, not engine-load protection. CODE: the value (0x40bdb6) is only ever compared with 12800 or with the learned closed position and span, never with engine speed or load; cm848_calculateVariableGeometryTurbochargerAdjustedPosition normalises it to a position, 1693 x 12800 / (12800 - 1920) = 1991 = both 0x40b098 and actuator_e_feedback in the dump; the sensor is the feedback of the actuator E servo (sign = direction output 71, magnitude = duty); the key-on stages drive that actuator with the mode 4 / mode 3 outputs (+3840 / -3840, subject to the mode output limits) until the sensor reads near 12800 (closed stop) or near the open stop and learn the reading and span there; fault bits 670 / 671 are the closed / span adjustment errors; fault 682 / 683 are the sensor high / low faults. E2M (corroboration only, e2m is the .12 file and the ECU is .06): the group Group_VGT has VGT_Position_Sensor / VGT_Position_Default (0x01196636 / 34), VGT_Closed_Position / VGT_Adjusted_Span / T_VGT_* saved values, VGT_Closed_Adjustment_Error / VGT_Span_Adjustment_Error at masks 16384 / 32768, VGT_Position_Source, and the C_VGT_* / C_VGA_* / T_VGT_* blocks match the CM848 words word for word at the same relative offsets (map validated by the independent pair boost value / default 0x0119660E / 0x01196626 = Charge_Press_Sensor / Default = 0x40bd8e / 0x40bda6). The unit is 1/128 percent (12800 = 100 percent, scale 0.0078125).

WHAT SURVIVES OF THE OLD READING: two debounced, latched adjustment error conditions (confirm-A / confirm-B = faults 670 / 671), their EMA filters and the substitution of a fixed fallback value (the channel default 9216) when the status is bad. WHAT DOES NOT: the monitored quantity (engine_load_percent 0x40af24 is read by none of the cluster functions: xref lists 9 other functions), any derate of engine speed or fuel (the derate target is the normalised position; nothing writes a governor limit), fuel-mode-B (the flag, was governor_fuel_b_mode_flag, is the enable of the whole position-servo module, 9 readers, all in it), the SPN 72 / 0x48 protection event (logical output request 72 is the neighbour of the direction output 71), and every speed name (all values are position x 128). The VARIABLE_GEOMETRY_TURBOCHARGER_SPAN_ADJUSTMENT_STATE enum is renamed for what the typed local holds (8 from fault 671); the same bit 8 is OR-ed untyped from fault 670 in cm848_selectVariableGeometryTurbochargerPositionSource.

RPM / PTO SPEED SETPOINT HYPOTHESIS (211..2117 rpm, 1152 rpm default): rejected. Consumers: (1) the cluster compares the value only with 12800 +- actuator_e_end_margin (1856), with the learned closed position and with the span tolerance 3200; (2) the actuator E loop subtracts it from the wastegate duty request on the same 12800 = 100 percent scale; (3) the 9216 default is the position default (72 percent); (4) the only rpm test in the cluster is current_rpm >= 4800 (600 rpm) for the mission reset, on a different word. No consumer treats it as 0.125 rpm per count.

THIS TRUCK (RAM dump, engine off, plus the four EEPROM dumps): the sensor value equals the table floor 1693; actuator_output_channel_e_cal = 0 (unassigned) and logical output 71 maps to no line, yet the module enable is 1, so the loop and the position code run; closed adjustment enable (EEPROM 0x450) 0, span adjustment enable 1, span / closed-position user overrides 1 / 1, so the position is sensor value x 12800 / 10880 and the learned values are bypassed; EEPROM 0x195c / 0x195e hold 9600 / 12800 in all four dumps. Fault 670 reads set (mask 16384 in fault_detected_bits_656_to_671): the error counter is 200 with the adjustment disabled because the delay limit is 0, so the elapsed flag (limit == counter == 0) is true even when the adjustment is off, and the sensor reads 1693 at dump time, outside 12800 +- 1856.
